title: Compose physical T74 with arbitrary-support routing
body:
PR3599 used a reference permutation around its physical T74 root. I replace that boundary with encoded forward exposure, the actual root, inverse exposure and complete record restoration, using PR3619's physical router. I keep actual grouped Gaussian coefficients throughout the root call and compile two fresh retuned natives in one authenticated class cohort.

Under the retained source contracts, I return `Q_p(H0_S x)`, where `Q_p` truncates components toward zero to the p-grid. I preserve borrowed payload/descriptors and restore owned-work baselines. I retain error below `sqrt(2)*2^-p` and return the ideal result exactly when it already lies on the p-grid.

I prove the complete conditional invoice

`O(V*(g^alpha*log p + (g+1)^tau*(log p)^(1+tau)))` time and `O(V)+F_q` space,

with `alpha=.99827101`, `tau=332353/332929`, fixed positive `c,C0,B`, `c*p<=n<=C0*p`, `g<=min(n,floor(p^.997))`, `log2(r+1)<=B*p`, and `V=2(p+2)*C*2^n*r`. I keep arbitrary positive outer rows C and the input unit-disk/source/native/hosting/refinement premises. I retain both time terms.

I pay the geometry fallback by an explicit cutoff. I lift short-record packets to precision `p+g`, execute exact single-bit returns on that grid, then round once at the final p-grid return. I include a physical mutant showing that original-p truncation after each bit changes the answer.

## Verification

I passed all seven registered Python 3.12 suites, the committed-byte/source-history check and the official export check at `757df5a1a4ef3b2594521db45fbea82f79bf2713`. I authenticate both parent exports and compare 36 Compact files and 23 ordinary backend files. I check 98 encoded extensions, a physical three-cycle, persistent coefficient counts, multiple rows/records, output reuse and eleven rejection controls.

The recursive fixture carries 512 Gaussian coefficients in a complete 10,240-bit packet, with five balanced child calls and 14 observed B1 selector calls at profile 1/577. I compare nonzero Walsh outputs across spectator labels against a rational oracle. The fallback witness returns `[-2,-1,0,0]`; premature physical truncation returns `[-1,0,0,0]`.

I use q=2 and declared reduced root guards/reservations, and a one-bit external suffix where declared. These composed packets use the router's literal branch; PR3619 separately checks its sparse branch. I have not executed production GL64/O(73,2) packets or admitted the inherited universal premises through finite tests.

I replayed all seven commands from the official committed export outside Git and confirmed unchanged bytes for all 17 regular files, including the receipt. Archive SHA256: `19da34fb207d781ff29405a3ad35d911333520deadfdb99ae872ba2bb721c433`. The export's recursive packet took 63.796 seconds locally; the lifted fallback took 136.650 seconds. I observed at most 25 wrapper leases, below the written 128-lease bound and fixed 256-role allocation. I also passed [CI39122404633](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39122404633) at the exact published head, including onboarding, package replay and unchanged committed inputs.

## Scope, coordination and attribution

I leave the selected frontier unchanged. The full-address schedule, older outer caller's diagonal/format/lifecycle work, raw-H scaling where required, and integer multiplication assembly remain open. I credit Chris / Clear1nsight's PR3623 (`328c40966b650f60b1d62cfb0b1d67b2b755eb62`) for its adjacent old-d/actual-g spacing audit. I derive spacing from actual g and restore the incoming frame; I do not claim that the old caller accepts this root unchanged.

I started from canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, revision 6, and recorded the expansion decision in the [canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-19009513). The complete publication refresh covered 338 open PRs and 2,452 Discussion records at 10:41–10:42 UTC on 2026-10-18, with zero warnings. Targeted checks through 11:13:56 UTC found no competing physical composition or substantive objection; main and the pinned source heads remained unchanged.

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, implementation, source analysis, verification and prose. Apache-2.0. I retain RaD/hipotures and Zhihao Chen's routing lineage, Vlado Vojdanovski's support/compiler argument, Douglas Colkitt's compact construction, my pinned predecessor components, Tekalign's normalization, Hiroki Kumazaki's PR3576 factory credit, Nick Petalas's PR3581 boundary and the nested native/borrowing/scalar notices. I claim no independent human or formal-kernel review.
